title: Checkout with a promo code
checked: Every reachable state checked (18 states, 62 with their data, 86 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 18 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: No order on a declined card
rules.says: An order is placed only after the bank said yes to this payment.
rules.path: Take away the card approved guard and it breaks in 8 steps: view cart, add item, check out, save address, choose delivery, confirm, pay, place order.

rules.rule: No checkout with an empty cart
rules.says: Nobody reaches the address step with nothing in the cart.
rules.path: Take away the has items guard and it breaks in 2 steps: view cart, check out.

rules.says: After three declined cards the shop stops asking for another one.
rules.path: Take away the tries left guard and it breaks in 16 steps: view cart, add item, check out, save address, choose delivery, confirm, pay, bank says no, try another card, pay, bank says no, try another card, pay, bank says no, try another card, pay.
